title: Road to bigger legs: 28 inches or bust!
summary: He tapes his 26-inch thighs and sets a 28-inch goal with no deadline. His approach: squats for quads, and a focus on lagging hamstrings, which should grow more easily and help protect the knees.

claims.claim: His thighs measure 26 inches and his goal is 28 inches, with no deadline: it could take five months or a year.
He will film every leg workout and post updates at 27 inches and at 28 inches.
His leg training philosophy is simple: squats for the quads, and a wide variety of exercises for the hamstrings.
To add thigh size he will prioritize hamstrings because his quads are much bigger than his hamstrings, so the lagging hamstrings have more easy growth left.
Developing the hamstrings also helps prevent knee injuries in the future.
His left leg is slightly bigger than his right; the right is also 26 inches but with slightly less quad and more hamstring.
Measure the thigh at its thickest part with the tape tight all around.
